# Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress.Testing

LeakProbe, ScaleProfile, FakeDialogs, FakeNavigator, FakeMainThread, FakeConnectivity, FakeMessageHub, ViewModelLifecycle, ScopedNavigator for unit tests.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress.Testing
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-avalonia-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 1.3.0

## Supported versions

net10.0 only. Test projects.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Avalonia.MVVMExpress.Testing

## Use this package when

- Tests need FakeNavigator / FakeDialogs / FakeMainThread / FakeConnectivity / FakeMessageHub, AppearAsync, ScopedNavigator pop-GC, or LeakProbe

## Do not use when

- Shipping in the app — this is a test helper package

## Alternatives

Hand-rolled fakes, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm test helpers, Prism test support.
